case.sample_identity: Yellow brick clay reference disk, no SSA, stated firing1020C; not root nominal sludge brick
case.physical_check: One preselected complete same-specimen tuple; check formulas/cached arithmetic and common input dependence, not model prediction
case.source_access: Existing original workbook and agent source read; DOI fresh access unavailable, not redownloaded

product_definition.dependency: Porosity,density,absorption share the same three weights and water-density value; not independent predictions.
product_definition.mass_basis_finding: Source E14 header m105 actually links the fired F9 mass, not pre-firing oven D9.
product_definition.source_protocol: Vacuum3h, immersed under vacuum1h, normal-pressure immersion24h; underwater weighing then wiped surface-dry weighing. Source accessible open porosity, no closed-pore measurement.
product_definition.host_mapping: Host W=connectivity*phi_gas*product.water_density/rho_bulk. phi_gas is not source vacuum-accessible open porosity; root connectivity remains assumed and cannot be inferred from this identity alone.

product.water_density.note: Ambient water density approximation used only for absorption proxy.

product_definition.host_process_reproduction: not admissible: no coherent full thermal history/geometric SI record for this selected source in current record; no fabricated cycle

sintering.source_relation: Wadsworth2016 free-venting spherical-pore viscosity is not this axial skeleton effective viscosity. No direct VFT transfer is justified by units alone.
sintering.source_review: docs/sandbox/research/wadsworth2016-sintering-data-v1/REPORT.md; 2283 prior exposed data comparisons and failures retained without rerun
sintering.applicability: Small effective axial strain, connected-pore continuum assumed. Positive gas/pore inventory and positive viscosity do not establish pore connectivity. No invented critical porosity, pore closure, fracture or glass-mineral phase qualification.

cooling.implemented: Shared caloric quartz transition, finite-rate matrix disorder and reversible elastic strain coupled to heat/gas/chemistry; heat counted once.
cooling.source_qualified: Pure quartz caloric reference points only; current effective strain/modulus and retained-disorder proxy remain assumed.
cooling.scope_limit: Not thermal-shock cracks, mineral polymorph completeness, measured crystallization or measured glass fractions.

product_prediction.defined: Final volume/mass/density/porosity/shrinkage from state; absorption connectivity proxy, strength and defects empirical exploratory indicators.
product_prediction.external_status: One complete source observation definition audit passed; coherent process reproduction not admitted because thermal history/geometric units/closed pores unavailable.
product_prediction.dependent_observations: Open porosity,density,absorption reuse the same three weights, not three independent confirmations.
product_prediction.engineering_use: Strength/defects/absorption proxies cannot certify real product compliance.

source_scan_policy: Reused targeted existing source records and three current P16 trajectories; no broad literature search, oldWadsworth rerun or target-data waiting.
